text.description_html:
AHI SD-SIG405-355-630, 14 Inch Stainless Ladder Style Glass Door Handles

14 inches long with a 6 inch center to centers, this ladder style glass door handle set is made of stainless steel by AHI Hardware. The warm Satin Stainless Steel finish requires little maintenance and is designed to enhance any setting where a clean ,contemporary look is desired. The contemporary ladder style back to back pair feature a nice sized 1-1/4 inch round grip handle that is very comfortable. Packaged with glass door mounting kit.

Specifications for the AHI SD-SIG405-355-630 Ladder Style Handles:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 14" (355 mm)
  • Mounting Centers: 6" (152 mm)
  • Projection: 3" (76 mm)
  • Handle Diameter: 1-1/4" (27 mm) Round
  • Handle Diameter: 32 mm (1-1/4") Round
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.
  • AHI SIG405-355 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Packaged with 2 door pulls and mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.
